text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day. While working in my
office...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The day where one gives chocolate as a
token of
appreciation! I, too, followed
the tradition and
prepared these for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, don't be shy! Hurry up and try
some!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going along with her request, I open up
the
parcel handed to me to reveal a
selection of
bite-sized chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter? You won't have
any?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Truthfully, the idea of consuming
something
offered by her scares me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But if I refuse...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I did my best to make these.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Steeling my resolve, I pop some of the
chocolate
into my mouth.
choice_data_list: （もし本当に真心を込めていたら……！）
choice_data_list_en: (If she really put her heart and soul into it...!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate melts in my mouth with a
velvety
creaminess, unveiling a
delectable sweetness that
isn't
overbearing in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, why of course it is. Did you think I
would
mess up something as simple as
making
chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But never mind that. Excuse me for a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon comes over and leans in
close.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I recoil instinctively. Agnes Tachyon, on
the other
hand, seems rather content.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Excellent, just what I wanted! This was a
success!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it! I got the results I
wanted!
Thank you for your cooperation,
guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without elaborating, Agnes Tachyon
leaves the
office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, do you smell that? Doesn't it smell
like
chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It does! Y'think it's Valentine's
chocolate? Smells
so sweet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't take long for me to realize my
body has
started to smell like chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel the sweet flavor permeating the
inside of
my mouth. A rich taste of
chocolate... No, of...
pork... and garlic...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's something called allithiamine, which
is great
for alleviating fatigue.
choice_data_list_en: It tastes like a pork bowl?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Long story short, I combined ingredients
that
contain ample amounts of vitamin
B1 and allicin,
then compressed those
into what you ate earlier.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I did it out of consideration for your
fatigue.
Chocolates also have the same
sedative effect
that aids in reducing
anxiety, but they end up
raising blood
sugar levels as a side effect.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In any case, wasn't it delicious?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good! I'm glad to hear that! I didn't
perform a
taste test, you see!
choice_data_list: 味は美味しかったけど……

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she begins to speak, she takes a
piece of the
pork-bowl-flavored
chocolate and tosses it into
her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? How intriguing. The dissimilarity
between
the outer appearance and its
actual substance is
quite extreme.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You think you're eating chocolate only
to
experience the complex flavors of a
pork bowl...
What a horrendous betrayal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly crave for sweets. All right,
you there,
make something for me right
now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry hurry! I want to eat the
real stuff!
I want dessert now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate cake, chiffon cake, anything
will do, so
long as it's sweet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At her request, I head into the kitchen
to begin
baking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After some time, the scent of freshly
baked
chocolate cookies pervades the
kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wow! They look tasty! I applaud your
effort,
guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with these lip-smacking cookies I
made, I
spend a heartwarming
Valentine's Day together
with Agnes
Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day isn't so bad after all!

Ha-ha-ha-ha!
